Would like to have some more details here.
Ok , I have added few more lines explaining the details of this class .
Have a config Manager shared pointer as well as that is not going to be via worker going forward.
What is the use case of this API?
Doxygen does not have parameter details.
We will need a member to hold worker object as well.
This can be checked in place, don;t need an API for this.
Why one is unique and another is shared? Any specific reason?
Currently as per your review comment , ThreadManager class ctor expects shared pointer to configmanager hence I have kept it as shared pointer .
Thread safe wrapper? I did not get that actually what you meant with that.

My view is that this class will orchestrate the threads. With the description I am getting the impression that it will implement some logic which will make access to the mentioned class in a thread safe way.

Why should thread manager expose an API to give config JSON?

This API should be in config manager?

Agreed , but from the story description , it says that ThreadManager class will hold the ConfigManager object via which ,we can call public APIs of ConfigManager class. Hence I introduced this method. It can be removed , I added these methods thinking if it can help in anyway, in future implementation of this class .
Correct but that was the initial design when thread manager was supposed to own config manager, now config manager is owned by manager, so thread manager need not expose this API.
This is not required in this patch set.
Same here, is this required? If no then please remove.
What is the brief? One liner is required here?
what is the purpose of thread manager class is missing ?
should we declare these variables as const ?
should we add new compile time flag instead, so it will be easy to enable for testing ?
As of now it has been kept as #if 0 to avoid meson changes, we will bring in conditional compilation flag in future phases of implementation.
